task.outcome:
Preserve the selected pipx/uv manager's executability in isolated release installation probes without exposing user state.
Confirmed at d8543630b5a4fe4f01d695ac25b9bc89204a7245. Owner scripts/release_install_metadata_smoke.py _isolate_probe_state:406-425 and pipx/uv-tool call paths:2360-2490. Install uses absolute manager found outside probe env, then probe PATH is reset to script_dir + os.defpath. Disposable executable controls for pipx and uv are found before isolation and disappear after it. Actual managers in Homebrew/user bin locations can therefore install successfully while updater ownership probe cannot discover them. Prior installed matrix failed update rows for pipx/uv; pipx additionally has UPDATE-PIPX-PATH-IDENTITY. Independent manager-removal cause is confirmed; no claim that every observed row has this sole cause.

Smallest proposed correction: retain only the verified selected manager's discovery path in existing isolated probe owner, preserve credential-free HOME/cache/PATH isolation; no general environment inheritance and no code fix during intake.
